note: Machine-readable declaration of every connector used for published Signalpost observations. A connector may only contribute publishable observations when its acquisition mode is rights-clean and its licence/terms are recorded here. Experimental connectors are declared but quarantined and never publish.

exact_company_site_activity_v1.basis: Robots-respecting, bounded, identity-gated crawl of the company's own site. Content is retained as evidence with URL, retrieval time and content hash.

exact_company_site_news_activity_v1.basis: Same bounded identity-gated crawl; only the company's own news/press/activity paths are read.

official_annual_report_workforce_v1.licence: Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data (NLOD) 2.0
official_annual_report_workforce_v1.basis: Official annual-account copy PDF from Regnskapsregisteret, matched by organisation number present in the document.

wikidata_identity_v1.basis: Entity matched by the Norwegian organisation-number property P233. No name-similarity-only matches are published.

openstreetmap_places_v1.basis: OpenStreetMap feature matched to the exact legal entity by the Norwegian organisation-number tag (ref:no:orgnr / organisasjonsnummer). Name-only matches abstain.

google_news_rss_exact_title_experiment_v.basis: Discovery only. Exact legal name must appear in the headline. Publisher bodies and result storage rights are not independently verified, so these observations are quarantined and never published.
